rationale: A commits to an architectural drawing-set language made for this brief (line-drawn town-hall elevation that draws in under a staggered headline by 1.3 s, plate captions, tally-mark section numerals, an isometric frame that assembles into a clad red house across the pinned process section, a title-block footer) and every frame, hover state and phone viewport is complete and legible. B has the lusher imagery (aurora and sunset project posters, a horizontal work gallery, a staged site-plan drawing, wood-grain NORR footer lettering), but its desktop entrance sits on a preloader reading 000% for the whole capture (still stuck at ~5.7 s and in the 'after entrance' frame), so the hero is never seen on desktop and the phone's first viewport is also only the loader. B's custom cursor ring also covers the labels it hovers and the Enquire pill loses its text on hover, whereas A's inverted-fill and underline hovers are crisp and unambiguous.
